variety: Spanish phrases that are identical in Argentina and Mexico, so either female voice may read them. Argentine accent is welcome but not required.
pronunciation_note: English-style respelling, capitals mark the stressed syllable. Argentine accent: "ll" and "y" sound like "sh".

phrases.when: Ask it at the counter when you have not seen a menu. Staff will list what they have.
Point at the cake or sandwich while you say it. Add “por favor” to sound kind.
Ask before you order if you have no cash. Many small cafés prefer cash.
A warm compliment for the cook. Argentines also say “Está riquísimo”.

hook: Chat with café staff in Spanish. Four phrases.

quiz.prompt: You have no cash. What do you ask?

outro: Say them out loud. Directions are next.
